name: Cut vs. Bulk Diagnostic & Phase Periodization Blueprint
description: Lifters second-guess whether to cut or bulk first, leading to short, reactionary cycles that stall long-term muscle building and body composition progress.
buyer: Beginner and intermediate lifters (especially skinny-fat individuals) uncertain about phase selection
core_problem: Lifters second-guess whether to cut or bulk first, leading to short, reactionary cycles that stall long-term muscle building and body composition progress.
desired_outcome: Clear, objective clarity on whether to start with a cut, bulk, or recomp, along with a structured 8–12 month phase roadmap to eliminate decision anxiety.
current_solutions: Body fat percentage rule of thumbs
Following generic advice based on training experience
solution_gaps: Generic rules of thumb ignore key variables like psychological fatigue, current training age, and personal strength baselines.
Simple quizzes do not offer long-term macro-cycle timelines, leaving lifters prone to panic-pivoting after a few weeks.
possible_product: Interactive Phase Diagnostic Calculator & Multi-Month Periodization Planner
basis: Lifters lack diagnostic tools that combine body composition metrics with multi-phase planning, causing perpetual cycle switching.
path: Lifters planning a cut or bulk
